subject: Next steps: private/VPC architecture review & demo availability
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: John Patel <john.patel@healthnova.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: private/VPC architecture review & demo availability

Hi John —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can move toward a technical deep dive / architecture review for a Private/VPC deployment. I captured the things we discussed and what we'd like to align on before the call.

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary use case: inference for clinical document ingestion and summarization (batch + low-latency API).
- Data residency: on-prem / VPC required for PHI handling; compliance team will need SOC2 + audit logs.
- Expected QPS: 40–60 requests/minute at peak, 1–2k token avg per request.
- Success criteria: <200ms p50 gen latency for summary endpoint under typical load, predictable cost envelope.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute private/VPC architecture review (technical deep dive + ops runbook). High-level agenda below and pre-call asks so we can bring the right folks.

Agenda (60–75 min)
1) Intros & goals (5 min)
2) Workload profile & traffic patterns (10 min)
3) Network & security constraints (15 min)
4) Deployment options (on-prem vs VPC vs hybrid) and recommended topology (20 min)
5) Implementation checklist, ownership, next milestones (10–15 min)

Pre-call asks
- Can your ops team share network ranges / firewall requirements for the VPC/on-prem environment (cidr list preferred)?
- Who from your security/compliance team should join? We normally loop them in for the first 20 minutes.
- Any constraints on outbound connections (e.g., fully air-gapped)?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Jun 16: 09:00–10:15 or 13:30–14:45
- Thu Jun 17: 11:00–12:15 or 15:00–16:15

If those don't work, share a couple of slots and I will coordinate with Ava (our solutions lead) and our infra engineer.

Attachments: redwood_privdeploy-prereqs.pdf (short checklist), healthnova-network-ranges.xlsx (template).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.ai)

---
P.S. I also added the draft mutual action plan to the HubSpot deal (link above).
From: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@healthnova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@healthnova.com>, sec-team@healthnova.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: private/VPC architecture review & demo availability

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. Rebecca here (platform engineering). We talked internally with security; they want an architecture review before any demo that touches production data. A few notes and availability below.

Quick notes from security:
- We will need SOC2 evidence and an example audit log export format prior to the call (not a blocker, just for review).
- Air-gap is not required at this stage, but egress must be limited and approved ranges will be enforced.
- We'll likely request a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) draft during procurement.

Availability (PT) — our core infra folks can do:
- Wed Jun 16: 10:30–12:00 (note: narrow overlap with your first slot)
- Thu Jun 17: 14:00–15:30
- Fri Jun 18: 08:30–09:45

We'll aim to include: me (platform), John (product), and their security lead (cc'd). I've attached the network template filled with our current ranges (healthnova-network-ranges.xlsx).

I'll also drop the security contact (sec-team@healthnova.com) a short note with the SOC2 ask.

Thanks —
Rebecca Lin
Platform Engineering Manager, HealthNova Therapeutics
(rebecca.lin@healthnova.com)

Attachment stub: healthnova-network-ranges.xlsx (spreadsheet with CIDR blocks)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Thanks Rebecca — this works. Let's lock Wed Jun 16 at 10:30 PT for a 75-minute architecture review. Ava (solutions) and I will cover deployment topologies and runbook items; we'll bring our infra engineer for kernel/quantization/latency discussion.

Confirmed details:
- When: Wed Jun 16, 2027 — 10:30–11:45 PT (75 minutes)
- Attendees: Rebecca Lin (platform), John Patel (product), security-team (sec-team@healthnova.com), Jordan Blake (AE), Ava Chen (Solutions Engineer), infra engineer (will join)
- Meeting link: Zoom (I'll send calendar invite with link)
- Pre-read: redwood_privdeploy-prereqs.pdf (attached), draft SOC2 evidence example (we will share privately via secure link before the call)
- Prep asks (before the call): healthnova to confirm firewall rules + any proxy requirements; security to list any specific logging/retention SLA questions.

Action items
- Jordan: send calendar invite + Zoom link, attach prereq checklist (done).
- Rebecca: confirm final attendee list and whether procurement needs to be on the call.
- Ava: prepare a one-page ops runbook (deployment steps, rollback, monitoring) and a short quantization/throughput note for the infra segment.

Jordan Blake
